config.description: Modulo-five preset decoder with both wraps. Full JSON colour-temperature and brightness preset actions map to the same hardware index; the first available family advances and its same-index partner is ignored. Ambiguous or unknown preset input cancels any pending secret chord, without guessing a direction.
